title: Update PPD files for Gutenprint drivers
summary: Run the cups-genppdupdate command to update Printer Description files if you see errors about PPD version incompatibility with Gutenprint.

steps.explain: Run the PPD update utility to regenerate printer description files.

rollback.explain: If printing breaks, restore the previous PPD files from backup or reinstall the printer driver.

warnings: This command modifies system printer configuration files.
